scope: FormData(form[, submitter]) serialization of standard HTML input, button, select and textarea controls
implemented: Named successful controls in tree order, including duplicate names and explicit form ownership
Disabled controls, disabled fieldsets with the first-legend exception, and datalist exclusions
Checked checkbox/radio values, selected options, disabled optgroups, textarea values and file inputs
Submitter validation, named submit buttons and zero-coordinate image submitters
Existing File and Blob identity preservation through append, set and form file serialization
remaining_scope: No form-associated custom-element lifecycle or ElementInternals support is added
No formdata event dispatch, object/plugin controls or dirname directionality entries are added
File serialization consumes an existing files collection; this does not add FileList or upload-control lifecycle machinery

Single-select fallback covers ordinary parsed controls and existing explicit selection state; full implicit selectedness updates after later option insertion/removal remain part of the existing DOM-control implementation
